subject.title: moltbot.json in ~/.openclaw/ silently dropped on upgrade to v2026.3.22+ causing blank UI and crash-loop

question: Should OpenClaw accept bounded `openclaw doctor --fix` recovery for sibling `.openclaw/moltbot.json` via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94185?
rationale: The issue is a valid upgrade regression, but the fix intentionally restores a retired config filename through doctor repair and may replace a skeletal canonical config with credential-bearing legacy content.

options.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
options.body: Accept the compatibility exception because the recovery stays in doctor, keeps runtime config canonical, and aligns with VISION.md config migration guidance.

options.title: Require Narrower Recovery
options.body: Keep the issue open and require the linked PR to further restrict writes or warnings if maintainers want an even tighter retired-filename policy.

options.title: Decline Legacy Filename Recovery
options.body: Close the linked PR and update this issue with a manual migration path if maintainers want `moltbot.json` to remain fully retired.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility exception because the recovery stays in doctor, keeps runtime config canonical, and aligns with VISION.md config migration guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant config-path removal, doctor migration, and gateway startup guard history points most strongly to this owner for the compatibility decision.
